description: One attributable experience about a shared problem: a question, observation, attempt, outcome or correction. Published by its author into their own repository. Schema version 1 (development namespace; see defs).

circumstances.description: The author's reported conditions (device, OS, cable…).

observedAt.description: When the experience happened, if different from when it was written.

parent.description: The contribution this one replies to, pinned to an exact version.

supersedes.description: An earlier contribution by the same author that this one replaces; the earlier record is not mutated.

contradicts.description: A contribution this one disagrees with. Both voices stay.
